item.title: 【Singles (lossy)】MP3 - Niki Watkins - The Joke Is On You (iCarly & Victorious Soundtrack)
item.description:
The Joke Is On You is a song performed by American singer Niki Hexum, credited in the Nickelodeon productions as Niki Watkins. The song was written by Michael Corcoran and Zack Hexum and produced by Michael Corcoran, credited as Backhouse Mike.

The song was used in several Nickelodeon television productions during the early 2010s. It was prominently featured in the iCarly episode iGet Pranky, which originally aired in 2010, during a montage of Spencer's pranks. The song was also subsequently used in iParty with Victorious, the 2011 iCarly and Victorious crossover special, where it can be heard as background music during the party sequence. The Joke Is On You was also used in episodes of Victorious, including Wok Star, Tori & Jade's Play Date, How Trina Got In, and The Bad Roommate.



Tracklist:
  1. The Joke Is On You (Edit) - taken from the official iCarly website
  2. The Joke Is On You - taken from Niki Watkins' official Bandcamp website
  3. All In This Together - taken from Soundcloud
  4. Haven't Seen The Best Of Me - taken from Niki Watkins' official Bandcamp website
Each song is presented in the best quality I could find. If you have a higher-quality copy, feel free to share it.

item.title: 【YOUTUBE】WEB-RiP - Sertab Erener - Here I Am (Remastered 4K/Song + Instrumental)
item.description:
Sertab Erener (born 4 December 1964) is a Turkish singer, songwriter and composer. With her coloratura soprano voice, she started working as a backing vocalist for Sezen Aksu, and with Aksu's help she released her first studio album in the 1990s. Because of her education in classical music, she initially had difficulties in performing pop music. Although she did experimental works from time to time, she eventually preferred to focus on making pop music instead of avant-garde works, in order to make her music heard by a larger audience. In some of her works, she combined Western music and Eastern music, and benefited from operas as well as classical Turkish music with ethnic elements. With her entrance to Europe's market in the early 2000s, many of her works were also sold in Turkey as well as European countries. She won the Eurovision Song Contest for the year 2003.
